episodes.synopsis: Shaman Yoh Asakura offers to help his new classmate Manta face a notorious thug with the aid of a legendary samurai spirit.
episodes.title: The Boy Who Dances with Ghosts

episodes.synopsis: Yoh and Manta encounter the shaman Ren, who shows no mercy when fighting a punk. Furious at Ren's misuse of his powers, Yoh faces him in battle.
episodes.title: Another Shaman

episodes.synopsis: Anna tells Yoh about the new tournament to crown the next Shaman King. Ren's sister Jun challenges Yoh to a battle, with Amidamaru as the prize.
episodes.title: Anna and Tao Jun

episodes.synopsis: After possessing Ryu, Tokageroh takes Manta hostage. Yoh and Amidamaru fight him, but Tokageroh wields Harusame and they're at a disadvantage.
episodes.title: Happy Place

episodes.synopsis: One of the Patch Officiants, Silva, unleashes his five animal spirits against Yoh to determine if he's worthy of participating in the Shaman Fight.
episodes.title: Over Soul

episodes.synopsis: Now qualified for the tournament, Yoh faces his first opponent, Horohoro of Hokkaido, a proud Ainu shaman who can manipulate ice and snow.
episodes.title: Yoh vs. Horohoro!

episodes.synopsis: Faust VIII, a necromancer who can manipulate corpses, enrages Yoh when he targets Manta for sadistic experimentation before their match.
episodes.title: A Form of Courage

episodes.synopsis: With Ren as his next opponent, Yoh distances himself from Manta to ensure his friend's safety. Later, Yoh returns to Izumo to continue his training.
episodes.title: Progress

episodes.synopsis: The last battle in the preliminary round begins. Fated rivals Yoh and Ren fight to the limit, but who will punch their ticket to the main tournament?
episodes.title: Yoh vs. Ren: Again!

episodes.synopsis: Ren returns to China to take care of unfinished business. The BōZ Brothers ambush Yoh and Tamao, but a familiar face comes to their rescue.
episodes.title: Night in the Flame

episodes.synopsis: Back home, an imprisoned Ren vows to defeat his father after losing to him in a fight. Meanwhile, Yoh and the others set out for China to rescue Ren.
episodes.title: A Tale of Two Men

episodes.synopsis: Ren and his allies make their way toward En. The head of the Tao family may be a formidable foe, but Yoh and company aren't ones to back down.
episodes.title: Ren vs. En: The End of the Tao

episodes.synopsis: Yoh's group meets the self-proclaimed future king. Those in the main tournament board a flight, not knowing their first trial is about to begin.
episodes.title: And Hao!

episodes.synopsis: As Yoh and the others prepare to travel to a town where a Patch Tribe village once stood, the dowser Lyserg appears and asks to join their group.
episodes.title: Lyserg the Avenger

episodes.synopsis: Yohmei tasks Anna with delivering an ancient book belonging to the Asakura family to Yoh in the United States. Horohoro's guardian Kororo goes missing.
episodes.title: When the Pieces Come Together

episodes.synopsis: Searching for answers, Yoh and company arrive at the ancestral village of the Patch Tribe, where they find themselves beset by Hao's followers.
episodes.title: Enter the Ultra-Pompandour

episodes.synopsis: Facing Boris, Ryu unleashes a new power acquired from his training with Yoh's grandfather Yohmei. An unexpected person appears before Manta and Anna.
episodes.title: Guns of the Angels

episodes.synopsis: Yoh's group reaches the Patch Tribe Village as they find the Great Spirits and learn the purpose of the Shaman Fight. A cheery shaman joins the team.
episodes.title: Great Spirits and My Team

episodes.synopsis: While looking for Lyserg, Yoh and friends are confronted by Faust, who makes a startling offer. Finally the stage is set, and the Shaman Fight begins.
episodes.title: Jaguar

episodes.synopsis: Team Ren faces off against Hao's lackeys, Team Tsuchi-gumi. Joco recalls his past with a certain person after being cornered in a desperate situation.
episodes.title: Joco's Christmas

episodes.synopsis: The second Shaman Fight begins as Team X-I of the X-Laws take on Egypt's Team Niles. But X-I's newest member is someone Yoh's group knows all too well.
episodes.title: Iron Maiden Jeanne

episodes.synopsis: Team Funbari Hot Springs begins their first match versus the Icemen. But Yoh vows to defeat them with one attack thanks to the ultra senji ryakketsu.
episodes.title: I'll Go Anywhere with You

episodes.synopsis: Overwhelmed by Faust's new Over Soul, the Icemen crumble under the pressure — then launch a sub-zero counterattack as the end of the match approaches.
episodes.title: The Power of Yoh

episodes.synopsis: Yoh meets with Lyserg for a long-awaited conversation, but others lurking nearby intervene. Finally, X-Laws' team X-III takes on Hao's Hoshi-gumi team.
episodes.title: Trust No One

episodes.synopsis: Yoh watches helplessly as Team X-III desperately fights Hao, who reveals the secret of his birth and his thousand-year history with the Asakura clan.
episodes.title: The Great Onmyoji, Hao Asakura

episodes.synopsis: Yoh's friends are stunned by the revelation about Hao. Later, a mysterious masked man appears before Team Ren with an offer to make them stronger.
episodes.title: Mikihisa Typhoon

episodes.synopsis: Ren gains new power after taking on his powerful opponent. As the Shaman Fight continues, Hao's followers begin targeting teams outside the ring.
episodes.title: Farewell Forever

episodes.synopsis: Horohoro and Joco try to escape Hao's follower Peyote Díaz with an injured Ren, but Yoh makes a surprising entrance. Elsewhere, Anna makes her move.
episodes.title: Yoh's Decision

episodes.synopsis: As Anna helps Mikihisa's teammates escape to their Shaman Fight, Tamao and Jun's battle against Hao's Hana-gumi heats up.
episodes.title: Emeth

episodes.synopsis: Yoh accepts Jeanne's conditions as payment for healing Ren, leaving their friends in shock. Anna recalls the first time she met Yoh five years ago.
episodes.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile

episodes.synopsis: Yoh tries to understand his fiancée, who continues to reject him and her connection to the demon attacking the town. Matamune's past is revealed.
episodes.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile ||

episodes.synopsis: Bit by bit, Anna and Yoh get closer when they visit the shrine together for New Year's. But Anna's powers bring on a dangerous situation.
episodes.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile |||

episodes.synopsis: Yoh and Matamune arrive at Mt. Osorezan to rescue Anna from the giant demon born from people's hearts, but Yoh only has one shot to save her.
episodes.title: Mt. Osore Le Voile IV

episodes.synopsis: Yoh's path to being Shaman King is over. Ryu and Manta spy on Jeanne's successful resurrection of Ren, which has an unexpectedly powerful side effect.
episodes.title: To Be King

episodes.synopsis: Horohoro finishes the fight with Brocken's team. Lyserg brings an injured Horohoro to Yoh's team when Peyote attacks with the intent to kill.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Mikihisa's teammates, siblings Ludsev and Seyram, seek revenge against the person who killed their father. But Yoh steps in before it's too late.
episodes.title: Redseb and Seyrarm

episodes.synopsis: Golem's new user goes on a rampage while Ren, Ludsev and the others come up with a plan to bring them back to their senses. Hao gives Opacho a task.
episodes.title: Winds of Laughter

episodes.synopsis: Opacho appears in front of Yoh with a message: Yoh must return to the Shaman Fight or Hao will destroy Golem and the children. What will he decide?
episodes.title: Graduation

episodes.synopsis: Yoh's battle with X-Laws to re-enter the Shaman Fight comes to an end as Luchist Lasso and Jeanne enter the fray. Later, Yoh reveals a plan to beat Hao.
episodes.title: The Summit

episodes.synopsis: As the Shaman Fight matches enter the final stages, Team Ren faces a fierce battle against The Wisdom Kings, who can nullify a person's Over Soul.
episodes.title: Humility

episodes.synopsis: Horohoro clinches the win for Team Ren, meaning their next opponent is Team Funbari Hot Springs. Meanwhile, a dubious group approaches Yoh and others.
episodes.title: Encounters in Hell

episodes.synopsis: Yoh continues to fight his way through hell with his new ability. As the Shaman Fight gets more complicated, an unprecedented trial awaits Yoh's team.
episodes.title: A Great Trial

episodes.synopsis: Marco and the others desperately resist Hao's attack to keep Jeanne safe. Hao's clash with the X-Laws causes an unexpected crisis.
episodes.title: The End of a Dream

episodes.synopsis: Hao's lackeys begin to doubt his intentions. Anna confronts Hao, who reveals his ultimate oversoul. Yoh's group steps into the Shaman Fight ring.
episodes.title: A Leisurely Chat

episodes.synopsis: The Shaman Fight between Team Funbari Hot Springs and Team Ren begins! But before Yoh can launch his counterattack, the match takes an unexpected turn.
episodes.title: The First and the Last

episodes.synopsis: Yoh and the others enter the area for the second tournament, but before it can begin, Yoh makes a surprising declaration.
episodes.title: True Justice

episodes.synopsis: The winner of the Shaman Fight will finally be revealed. Yoh and the others try to stop Hao from joining with the Great Spirit.
episodes.title: Plants

episodes.synopsis: Yoh and the others are giving it their all, but despite their best efforts and sacrifices, Hao manages to reach the King's shrine.
episodes.title: All the Way

episodes.synopsis: Yoh and the others arrive at Patch Officiant Kalim's residence, where they decide to take a well-earned rest. But soon, a surprise arrives.
episodes.title: Good Night

episodes.synopsis: During the battle against Kalim, the darkness that has been burdening Horohoro finally comes to light.
episodes.title: Falling Damko

episodes.synopsis: The group finally makes it to the final plant where they face Rutherfor, their most formidable opponent yet.
episodes.title: Last Test: Shaman Fight

episodes.synopsis: Hao releases the might of his newly acquired powers against Yoh and the others, but the scrappy crew refuses to give up hope.
episodes.title: Shaman King: God End
